design.decision: one generated lightweight distribution repository per registered semantic dataset; dataset identity, TF schema version, immutable release identity, and upstream source state remain distinct

tdd.adversarial_regression_red_result: 3 failed, 186 passed, 1 skipped; failures were loadability-before-visibility, forbidden payload leakage, and corrupted-current-tree replay
tdd.validator_side_effect_red_result: 5 failed because Text-Fabric validation mutated the directory being digested; fixed by validating an isolated copy

review.resolution: publisher rejects structurally complete but unloadable TF, rejects raw/build/research payload directories, verifies current visible release integrity before replay, and performs TF load validation on an isolated copy so validation cannot alter publishable bytes

benchmark.method: pinned Agora GitStore via loopback git daemon with /proc/net/dev RX+TX byte deltas
benchmark.result: historical benchmark: equivalent TF payloads loaded at exact immutable revisions; the generated minimal repository sharply reduced cold Git transfer and metadata/tree coupling while warm/no-change cost remained small

resume_gate: Re-ground PR #62 on current main, rerun focused/full/benchmark gates on the exact new head, then obtain a logically independent adversarial review of that exact head before marking done or merging.
